title: Theoretical Analysis of Byte-Pair Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2411.08671v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) is a widely used method for subword tokenization, with origins in grammar-based text compression. It is employed in a variety of language processing tasks such as machine translation or large language model (LLM) pretraining, to create a token dictionary of a prescribed size. Most evaluations of BPE to date are empirical, and the reasons for its good practical performance are not well understood.   In this paper we focus on the optimization problem underlying BPE: finding a pair encoding that achieves optimal compression utility. We show that this problem is APX-complete, indicating that it is unlikely to admit a polynomial-time approximation scheme. This answers, in a stronger form, a question recently raised by Zouhar et al.   On the positive side, we show that BPE approximates the compression utility of the optimal pair encoding to a worst-case factor between $1/3$ and $(1-e^{-2})/2 \approx 0.4324$.

translated_title: 字节对编码的理论分析
translated_abstract: 字节对编码（Byte-Pair Encoding，BPE）是一种被广泛使用的子词分词方法，其起源于基于语法的文本压缩。它被应用于多种语言处理任务，如机器翻译和大型语言模型（LLM）预训练，用于构建一个指定大小的词元字典。迄今为止，对BPE的大多数评估都是经验性的，其良好实际表现背后的原因尚未得到充分理解。本文聚焦于BPE背后的优化问题：寻找能够实现最优压缩效用的对编码。我们证明该问题是APX完备的，这表明它不太可能存在多项式时间近似方案。这以更强的形式回答了Zouhar等人最近提出的一个问题。从积极的角度来看，我们证明BPE对最优对编码压缩效用的近似，在最坏情况下介于1/3与(1-e^{-2})/2 ≈ 0.4324之间。
tldr: 本文证明BPE背后的优化问题是APX完备的（因此不太可能有好的多项式时间近似方案），同时证明BPE在最坏情况下能以1/3至约0.4324之间的因子近似最优对编码的压缩效用，从而为BPE的实际良好表现提供了理论解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the optimization problem underlying BPE is APX-complete, and shows that BPE approximates the compression utility of the optimal pair encoding to a worst-case factor between 1/3 and ≈0.4324, providing theoretical justification for its strong practical performance.
